name: Bright Outdoor Media Limited
summary: Bright Solar Ltd specializes in the assembly and integration of solar-powered pumping solutions, providing both direct current (DC) and alternating current (AC) solar pumps, as well as complete solar pump systems. Furthermore, the company undertakes Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contracts for solar photovoltaic water pumps. These comprehensive contracts cover the supply, installation, and commissioning of pump systems, complemented by ongoing maintenance agreements. Its product offerings span full solar water pumping systems, standalone DC and AC solar pumps, proprietary 'Bright Solar Marts,' and a range of other related products. The company's operations are categorized into three main segments: Solar Water Pumping and Other Solar Systems; System Installation and Consulting for Project Tendering and Infrastructure; and FMCG Sales. A significant majority of its income is derived from the sales generated by its Solar Water Pumping and Other Solar System segment.
